# The Deliberate Pause

> The mental game for founders. Founder psychology for entrepreneurs building without burning out, losing clarity, or turning output into identity.

The Deliberate Pause (TDP) is a founder-psychology platform from Avi Agarwal, co-founder of CreditVidya (acquired by CRED). The site separates evergreen website articles from weekly letters.

## Current Site Structure

- [Homepage](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/)
- [Articles hub](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/articles): evergreen on-site articles for organic search and AI citation
- [Letters](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/letters): weekly letters delivered through Substack
- [FAQ](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/faq)
- [About Avi](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/about)

## Founder Pain Categories

- [Founder Burnout](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/articles/category/founder-burnout): Articles on burnout, overwork, and the founder habit of turning exhaustion into identity.
- [Founder Resilience](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/articles/category/founder-resilience): Articles on rejection, agency, stuckness, and rebuilding the founder's inner operating system.
- [Founder Loneliness](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/articles/category/founder-loneliness): Articles on the quiet isolation of building, deciding, and carrying pressure at the top.
- [Overthinking & Anxiety](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/articles/category/overthinking-anxiety): Articles on overthinking, perfectionism, anxiety, and the founder's relationship with control.
- [Performance & Recovery](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/articles/category/performance-recovery): Articles on attention, rest, recovery, and sustainable founder performance.
- [Self-worth](https://www.thedeliberatepause.com/articles/category/self-worth): Articles on approval, identity, self-worth, and building without outsourcing your enoughness.

## Publishing Rules

- Articles live on the website under /articles and should not be duplicated on Substack.
- Letters live on Substack and are represented by /letters.
- Subscribe CTAs point to the newsletter subscription flow.
- Every article should include a canonical URL, Article schema, breadcrumb schema, author block, related links, and internal links to relevant article/category pages.
